screen.name: Your New Site
screen.purpose: Let the prospect experience the real responsive homepage while keeping questions, price and completion action accessible.
screen.secondary_outcome: Prospect proceeds to the completion offer

workspace_shell.preview_mode: The client homepage is rendered in its own isolated origin or sandboxed frame so its styles cannot collide with the Sorted shell.

constraints: Collapse support text on small screens

sections.behavior: Resize only the preview canvas; do not reload the page unless required by the embedded implementation

sections.presentation: white canvas with subtle border and 14px radius; no blur or image-only substitute
sections.loading_state: Sorted skeleton with text: Loading your homepage…
sections.error_state: Your preview is temporarily unavailable. Ask Sorted to restore it.

interactions.question_action: Open a compact question drawer or preferred messaging channel without leaving the preview state
interactions.next_steps_action: Navigate to the formal completion offer
interactions.keyboard: Viewport controls and all actions must be reachable in natural tab order

security.prospect_access: Unlisted signed URL or workspace token
security.preview_embedding: Use CSP/frame-ancestor rules compatible with the preview host, or proxy through an approved isolated preview origin
security.privacy: Do not expose CMS, analytics or private documents before purchase

mobile_rules: Workspace header uses a compact brand row and scrollable tabs
Primary completion action spans available width
Default to mobile preview mode on screens below 640px
Do not place a mobile preview inside an additional phone illustration

content_rules.shell_must_not_modify: The client homepage's brand, typography, navigation or content

reference_canvas.note: Reference is a tall capture; application viewport should use available browser height.

scrolling_contract.preferred: Workspace shell remains fixed/sticky; the live homepage scrolls inside PreviewViewport.
scrolling_contract.avoid: Two uncontrolled page scrollbars with unclear focus.
scrolling_contract.keyboard: When preview frame is focused, PageUp/PageDown and arrow keys operate the preview; Escape returns focus to workspace controls.

mobile_geometry.workspace_header: compact brand row plus scrollable prospect tabs

preview_isolation_contract.style_boundary: No parent Tailwind reset or global CSS may affect preview document.
preview_isolation_contract.navigation: Links within the homepage remain inside the preview only when a valid preview route exists; otherwise disable unfinished internal routes without visual breakage.

interaction_states.question_action: opens right-side drawer at 420px desktop width and full-screen sheet on mobile
interaction_states.completion_action: navigates to next-steps route preserving workspace identity
interaction_states.viewport_switch: animate preview width over 180ms; no opacity fade
interaction_states.loading: neutral skeleton blocks inside preview frame, never a spinner over the whole workspace

implementation_order: Test iframe keyboard and mobile behavior
do_not_infer: Do not recreate the prospect's homepage from this manifest
Do not place the website in a decorative laptop or phone device
Do not add a floating chatbot in phase 1

acceptance_criteria: The homepage is live and scrollable rather than a static mockup
The prospect can switch between desktop and mobile presentation
The exact price and next action remain visible without interrupting exploration
The client site styles cannot leak into the Sorted shell
The experience works without requiring a call
